name: workflow
description: Minimal task-board framework for hobby/solo repos: groom, run (one task inline, many in isolated workers, or a free-text ask matched onto the board), decision log, cross-repo status, framework-init scaffolding, framework-doctor health check and guides wizard. Tasks are files in workflow/<status>/ folders (folder = status, moves are git mv), board view via a shipped ./workflow/status script; validation, docs, and commit rules come from the repo's own instructions
